overview: Lean improvement project in the TB program: two value stream mapping days in November 2026 with nurses, clinic staff, the central office and hospital radiology, then redesign introduced in steps from January 2027, with completion charted by index-case month cohorts through December 2027.
population: All contacts of pulmonary tuberculosis cases notified by the program; baseline cohorts from January to December 2026, improvement cohorts from January to December 2027.
exposure: Redesigned pathway: blood draw at the first home visit (with courier pickup), results routed directly to the case nurse, chest X-ray booked at the result visit, interpreters booked for every step, and a standard work checklist for closing each contact.
procedures: A mapping team of two nurses, a clinic phlebotomist, a central office clerk and a radiology booker maps the current state with ten recent cases, then the future state. Changes are introduced one at a time, each tested with a small group of cases before spreading. The monthly extract (DS-114) includes identification, test, result, radiograph and closure dates; a missing-date check is run before each chart update.
